// One deck holding every kind of violation this checker reports, plus the two
// shapes it must stay quiet about. 98 cards in total, so the deck size is wrong
// as well.
1x Marwyn, the Nurturer [Commander{top}]

80x Forest [Land]

// Legal: the printed rule that lifts the copy limit outright, and green, so it
// sits inside Marwyn's identity too.
9x Slime Against Humanity [Payoff]

// Silent: the fixture index carries no `any_number` for Sylvan Library, and a
// checker that reads a missing field as "one copy only" is exactly the failure
// this whole feature could most easily become.
2x Sylvan Library [Draw]

// BG in a mono-green deck.
1x Assassin's Trophy [Interaction]

// Singleton, and the index says any_number is false.
3x Sol Ring [Ramp]

// Banned, and not legal in the format at all.
1x Mana Crypt [Ramp]
1x Sword of Dungeons & Dragons [Ramp]
